responsibility: Defines the core OpenRISC target macros that describe the ABI and machine model to GCC. It specifies preprocessor builtins, data layout and endianness, register numbering and allocation order, register classes, calling-convention and stack-frame conventions, PIC and elimination rules, trampoline and profiling settings, DWARF/EH register mappings, and other target properties consumed across the compiler backend.
same_name_distinction: Among the or1k files, this is the target-definition header that describes the machine model to GCC with preprocessor macros, register numbering, ABI, stack, PIC, and EH definitions. Unlike or1k.cc it does not implement hooks, unlike or1k.md it does not define RTL insn patterns, and unlike or1k.opt it does not declare command-line switches.
